newsitem.title: UK: Glynwed down after cautious UBS comment.
newsitem.headline: Glynwed down after cautious UBS comment.

text.p: Shares in Glynwed International Plc dropped on Thursday after cautious comment on the stock from analysts at UBS ahead of the company's annual general meeting on May 8, dealers said.
The stock was down 6-1/2p at 254-1/2 by 0817 GMT in thin trade of 56,000 shares.

In the wake of a tumble in Vickers Plc shares after its AGM warning over the strong pound, UBS highlighted Glynwed's vulnerablity to the currency's strength, arguing that the company's UK profit margins could come under pressure from cheap imports from continental Europe.
Analysts at UBS advised investors two switch out of Glynwed and into Siebe Plc, up 3p at 915, and FKI Plc, unchanged at 182p.
